decision: FUSION PARKED - fresh carve is R3D training data
discovered: after fit-split scoring, before any eval-split result was read

evidence.implication: 1600 train clips, 15% held out = the 240-clip carve; the 1360-clip remainder is the R3D training set, and the fresh carve was drawn entirely from it

why_invalid: no headroom: 2 missed Fight clips of 48 on fit, alarm budget 3 false positives; exact McNemar needs 6-10 net discordant clips, so no significant result was reachable in either direction (stop condition 6)

structurally unfair: YOLOv8s never trained on RWF-2000, so fusion would pit a memorized temporal branch against a non-memorized spatial one, biasing against fusion and making even a null uninterpretable

not_invalidated.spatial_characterization: measured on the existing 240-clip carve, which is R3D HOLDOUT data; YOLO trained on none of it

no_uncontaminated_set_remains.existing_240_carve: spent three times for selection, but IS genuine R3D holdout
no_uncontaminated_set_remains.primary_394: reserved for confirmatory evaluation; out of scope for this task

valid_path_forward: fit fusion on the existing 240-clip carve (selection-spent but genuine R3D holdout), then evaluate ONCE on primary 394 under a pre-frozen protocol; requires separate authorisation
